Sandbox_HephasVitamins_EnableSayings_too: If enabled, your character will say immersive/funny lines when getting healed by the vitamins intake.
Sandbox_HephasVitamins_FatigueChange_too: Adjusts how much fatigue is reduced when taking vitamins.
Sandbox_HephasVitamins_HealAmount_toolti: Determines how much health you recover when the healing effect triggers. Higher values restore more health.
Sandbox_HephasVitamins_HealPercent_toolt: Sets the chance (in %) that taking vitamins will heal you. Higher values mean a greater chance for a health boost.
Sandbox_HephasVitamins_StressChange_tool: Adjusts how much stress is added when taking vitamins. Default is 1 means taking a pill increases stress by 0.01.
Sandbox_HephasVitamins_UseDelta_tooltip: Controls how many times each vitamin item can be used. For example, a value of 1 means the item is consumed in one use, 0.5 allows two uses, 0.25 allows four uses, and so on. Lower values increase reusability.
Tooltip_PillsVitamins_Hephas: A bottle of vitamins. May help you recover some health and reduce fatigue.
